name: Vatican Computer Center (C.E.D.) / Vatican Datacenter
developer: Holy See (Vatican Internet Service / Vatican Apostolic Library IT Center)
notes: The Holy See's in-country institutional datacenter in Vatican City (Cortile Belvedere, 00120 Citta del Vaticano). Official Vatican Apostolic Library page describes the C.E.D./IT Center: ~5 PB EMC Isilon NAS cluster (35+5 nodes) and 2x EMC VNX SAN (30 TB each, VPLEX-replicated) distributed across two sites (Conciliazione and Belvedere), 100+ VMs on VMware (7 main + 3 backup compute nodes, ~212 GHz CPU, ~1 TB RAM), Cisco network with 512 static IPs (RIPE), BGP and 1 Gbps links to NAMEX/Cogent. Vatican Internet Service (VIS) acts as ISP/registrar for the .va domain, hosting web, mail, DNS and digital-archive servers. No commercial/colocation datacenter market exists in the 0.44 km2 territory, and no new-build datacenter projects (announced/planned/under construction) were found; most Church IT workloads run on-prem with some services hosted in Rome/cloud per LowEndBox (May 2025).
